full_judgment: 18. Be that as it may; it can be easily decided that fraud has vitiated the entire proceedings of this civil Rule, even then; for the interest of justice especially for complete justice I like to draw my attention over the evidence adduced from the sides of the respective parties in support of their respective cases. During trial of the original suit being Other Suit No.225 of 2000 the witness No.1 is the plaintiff himself who is Abdul Jabbar. The plaintiff in his testimony affirmed his respective pleadings as cited in his plaint and it is within his deposition that his father Mali Hossain purchased the suit land from the original owners Hem Chandra Dutta and 04 others prior to 50/60 years. Subsequently, at the demise of Mali Hossain his one wife, 08 sons and 03 daughters inherited his property. There has been an amicable partition among the brothers and sisters and the plaintiff acquired the suit land in his exclusive possession but one of his brother Bonde Ali out of ill-motive transferred the suit land in favour of the defendant No.1 namely Abdul Barik by a forged ewajnama deed by dint of which Abdul Barik on 08.10.2000 dispossessed the plaintiff from the suit property. With regard to the documentary evidence produced from the side of the plaintiff I find that the respective S.A. Khatian No.786 has been marked as Exhibit-1 and the subsequent deeds has been marked as Exhibits-2, 3, 4 and 5. The disputed exchange deed being No.6203 dated 19.09.2000 is exhibit-2 from the side of the plaintiff.
